study: Final-QA v2 paired-history offline feasibility pilot

roles.pilot_frame: previously inspected Final-QA Validation, reused as development data

fusion.selection_metric: supported-label macro-F1 on the pilot selection partition

pairing_control.method: SHA-256 ordered, fixed-point-free cyclic report-payload rotation

required: aligned fusion minus image-only macro-F1 is positive on the pilot holdout
aligned fusion exceeds the mean shuffled-pair fusion on the pilot holdout
go_rule.interpretation: A GO result justifies development of a deployable report-derived paired-history method; it is not confirmatory evidence.

boundary: This is an oracle-payload upper-bound diagnostic, not a preregistered or confirmatory experiment. The earlier aligned-history oracle result was already known before this v2 pairing-and-fusion pilot. Historical structured answers are derived from paired historical reports and are unavailable as direct labels in deployment. Validation was already inspected in Final-QA v1 and is development-only here; Test remains inaccessible.
